official_source_review.reviewed_fact: @pixiv/three-vrm is MIT licensed, loads VRM 0.x and 1.0 in Three.js, and VRM is a single-file runtime-loadable avatar format.

implementation_contract.injection: product-only WEB_HEAD extension; frozen research entrypoints unchanged
implementation_contract.renderer_runtime: one self-contained local IIFE bundle; no CDN or runtime network
implementation_contract.asset_transport: native browser file input to object URL; no Gradio upload and no server write
implementation_contract.initial_scene: neutral wireframe stage explicitly labeled as not a loaded VRM
implementation_contract.success_truth: rendering_vrm only after VRMLoaderPlugin returns a VRM instance and a rendered frame is observed
implementation_contract.failure_truth: wrong extension, over-limit file, parse failure or missing VRM instance ends in load_failed and never vrm_rendered
implementation_contract.replacement_cleanup: remove old scene and revoke prior object URL before replacement or clear

fixture_boundary.browser_success_fixture: temporary neutral untextured VRM 1.0 fixture generated from the public schema

terminal_failure: After two bounded bundle or renderer repair attempts, preserve the minimal counterexample and mark REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing dependency versions, downloading a model, enabling a CDN or weakening the truthfulness checks.
claim_boundary: This freeze authorizes implementation of a local rendering surface, not an avatar identity, animation intelligence, tool-controlled body, voice avatar or reference-person replica.
